description: The project URL and publishable (anon) key for supabase-js, as .env lines. The secret (server-only) key is included only with include_secret: true and the keys:secret scope; it bypasses row level security and must never reach client code. Scope: keys:read.

include_secret.description: Also return the secret key (needs keys:secret)

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

name: keys.get
title: Get URL and keys
